text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the birthday wishes. And 
thank you for the wonderful gift, too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The glasses stand was a big help. When it 
comes to displaying old glasses, you can 
never have too many.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You said the same thing before, didn't 
you? I'm glad Rob Roy and I each got you 
something separate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This antique-style glasses stand from you 
shows impeccable taste, Rob Roy-kun. Truly 
a choice befitting you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It brings warmth and a sense of nostalgia. 
I've decided to display the glasses I wore 
in my childhood.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so glad. I thought vintage glasses 
would go well with such a tastefully 
classic design...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Glasses that spent warm days together with 
me. I treasure mine as well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Also... on that sturdy metal stand Messiah 
gave me, I set my broken glasses.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Every time I look at it, it reminds me of 
when I went too far and broke it during 
training. It serves as a good reminder.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Past glasses are witnesses to the path of 
one's life. I also look at them from time 
to time to reflect on days gone by.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Looks like we'll have more days 
like this from now on. Allow me to thank 
you once again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you. It is a gift truly 
befitting a milestone birthday in one's 
life.
